segments.name: Mobile Solutions
segments.description: Provides filtration solutions for construction, mining, agriculture and transportation equipment through OEMs and dealer networks.
segments.evidence: The Mobile Solutions segment, which represents 62.3% of net sales in fiscal 2026, is organized based on a combination of customers and products and consists of the Off-Road, On-Road and Aftermarket business units.

segments.name: Industrial Solutions
products: compressed air and industrial gases purification systems
hydraulic and lubricated rotating filtration applications
segments.description: Provides industrial filtration equipment, components and services for manufacturing, power generation and aerospace and defense sectors.
segments.evidence: The Industrial Solutions segment, which represents 29.1% of net sales in fiscal 2026, is organized based on product type and consists of Industrial Air Filtration, Industrial Gases, Industrial Hydraulics, Power Generation and Aerospace and Defense products.

segments.name: Life Sciences
products: bioprocessing consumables including chromatography devices, reagents and filters
specialized air and gas filtration systems
segments.description: Provides filtration and bioprocessing solutions for food and beverage, data centers, semiconductors and bioprocessing applications.
segments.evidence: The Life Sciences segment, which represents 8.6% of net sales in fiscal 2026, is organized by end market and consists of the Food and Beverage, Disk Drive, Advanced Membrane Solutions, Microelectronics and Upstream and Downstream Bioprocessing markets.

revenueModel.text: OEMs, distributors and end users pay for filtration products and services that enhance equipment performance and manufacturing efficiency.
revenueModel.evidence: Mobile Solutions sells to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the construction, mining, agriculture and transportation end markets and to independent distributors and OEM dealer networks.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the Company acquired Filtration Group's Facet Filtration business to strengthen its aerospace and defense and power generation positions.
changes.evidence: During fiscal 2026, the Company acquired Filtration Group's Facet Filtration business (Facet), consisting of Facet (Oklahoma) LLC and Facet Netherlands B.V.
